verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own in-product AI analysis of customer data. Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence for relevance, scope and timeliness, and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots so they can be fixed before audit. It also offers AI-assisted due diligence reviews. Coverage is limited to these specific workflows rather than broad insights across compliance posture data, and the depth of the suggestions is not shown. Missing for 10: a general AI insights or recommendations layer across dashboards and risk data, detail on the suggestions generated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
